0.5m.source_level: LMM fitted-value arithmetic, NOT measured plant group mean

1.5m.source_level: LMM fitted-value arithmetic, NOT measured plant group mean

common_garden_separate_male_effort_ratio.source_report: Original authors report ratio based on male-flower biomass/aboveground biomass, NOT actual paternal genotypes or pollen germination

source_common_garden_seed_count_model_in.safe_conclusion: No significant difference detected by printed p and CI; do not treat narrative t=2.91 as reliable

limitation_receipt: Directly verified primary 2024 Table 2 coefficients and 95% CIs; numerical predictions are re-expression of fitted published linear model at 0.5 and 1.5 m, NOT new data fits or actual individual observations
Fruit failure proxy cannot isolate failure of pollen receipt from resource-mediated fruit abortion, although original authors interpret it as pollen limitation
Distance effect p<.001 and female offset p=.029 support original source-specific associations, but interaction p=.80 does not prove exactly equal slopes across morphs
CIs of each printed coefficient cannot be combined to produce correct CI for a full 0.5/1.5m prediction without covariance of fitted coefficients
No detected seed biomass response does not establish absence of fitness costs or compensatory seed maturation
Separate common garden has 383 female-function and 201 male-function analyzed plant outcomes; not same 71 distance experiment plants and not 109 field population records
Original printed seed-count-per-biomass model narrative t=2.91 p=.097 is internally statistically inconsistent; no fabricated correction chosen
Original 2024 authors' >12% detectable difference power statement is NOT a confidence bound or proof that femaleness lacks any benefit
Model restorer cost rho=.15-.4 is an assumed simulation regime chosen to match morph frequencies, not measured cost or a source-calibrated SLK module K
Full 109-pop supplement S1, 3-year count supplement S2, 64-cross S3 and 39-cross S4 not downloaded; raw data analysis not performed
No same-plant genotype-specific paternity, maternal genetic transmission, CMS allele or rare mutant invasion fitness measured
No SLK Phi, g0, Delta_R nor full joint fitness calculated from this published source
